per_claim.comment: Differs by 1 bp, which is within the ±1 bp tolerance for post-1995 updates.
GC% is very close (≈0.15% absolute difference) and consistent with an approximate 38.0% statement.
1.26% lower than the 1995 prediction, well within the ±5% re-annotation drift; modern annotation distinguishes 117 pseudogenes.
Operon count by 16S loci matches exactly; extra 5S copy does not change operon number.
NC_000907.1 is annotated as a single circular chromosome, consistent with the paper.

justification: All six headline claims are addressed and either match exactly (rRNA operons, topology) or fall within the specified drift tolerances (length ±1 bp, CDS and tRNA counts ±5%). The GC content is very close to the paper’s approximate value, consistent with expectations. These results align with post-1995 re-annotations while preserving core quantitative features of the original report.
